scope: MONDE01 M3 Step 0 (docs/M3_PLAN.md section 2): static targets for P1-P5 and S1. No emulation; nothing here claims that a branch runs.

labels.B: read from accepted state bytes (frame-128 checkpoint / M1) or an instruction encoding of the intact executable
labels.S: inferred: a translation run over those bytes, a reachability/ordering claim, or a preference

anchors.name: InputGame playfield cell mapping and guard

view.mapping: cell (x,y) = (cell mod 256, cell div 256); screen pixel = (32(x-vx)+16, 32(y-vy)+16); with view origin (0,0): (32x+16, 32y+16)
view.mapping_byte_evidence: InputGame 0x429800..0x42984a encodes cell = ((Y>>5)+[0x508722])<<8 + (X>>5)+[0x508720] for MouseZone result 0 (dispatch 0x42c2a5), guard 0x42984c..0x4298c6 d*32 <= X < (vw-d)*32, d*32 <= Y < (vh-d)*32 with d = s8 [0x508f90]. Encoding B; that a click reaches it is S.

mouse_zones.builder_selection_effect: S: InitGameZone mode 1 (the in-game layout) reads screen size, minimap flag/position, viewport, panel offset, contact/message-box/alliance state; not the selection. Selecting the builder therefore adds no MouseSetZone rectangle; the action icons are hit-tested by IconeGetZone inside zone 11.

action_icons.label: B (IconeGetZone 0x45da4e constants; screen width 800 -> y0 = 0x224)
action_icons.selection_rule: InputGame 0x42bcd9: icons index the bag of the selected structure (BatimentGetSelection) or, when exactly one unit is selected (EnginGetNbSelection == 1), that unit's EnginGetBagOrdre; icon slot s reads bag entry bag[+4] + s (BagGetCode +0x42, BagGetType +6).

mouse_zones.unavailable_minimap_cells: S: centre pixels of cells with x-vx <= 3 and y-vy <= 3 fall in zone 10 (minimap)

units.hit_test: B encoding: InputGame 0x429ae3 hovers the unit ChercheIndiceEngin(cell) at the clicked cell; the selection producers 0x42b9aa/0x42ba20 were not traced here (open)

cave_icon.label: B (rect, bag bytes); S (that a click reaches it)

cave_icon_click.label: B encoding, S reachability
cave_icon_click.effect: code 3 entry -> BatimentGetRessource(type) then TestRessource(player, food, stone, 0); on success with type != 0x14: u16 0x4e05ae := 3, u8 0x496207 := type (0x42c1e6..0x42c1f5)
cave_icon_click.requires: u8 0x5099ae and u8 0x5099af both nonzero in the same InputGame pass

cave.cost_label: B (table 0x495d98 + 52*type, read by BatimentGetRessource and CreerBatiment)
cave.placement: S: CalculConstruireBatiment builds when unit +8 == +0xb2 (the clicked cell), at cell +8 + 0x202 (CreerBatiment reference = bottom-right); origin = reference - (w-1) - (h-1)*256, i.e. the 5x5 footprint centred on the clicked cell, the same footprint BatimentPosable tests at the click.
cave.owner_after_creation: B: CreerBatiment stores owner +4 = 0xc8 (0x4200b5); only types 0x11 (0x4200c8) and 9/0xc (0x420295) get the player byte there. The only store found that turns a 0xc8 owner into a player is BatimentLogeEngin 0x41fa77 (symbol-bounded linear scan, not exhaustive).

to_gather_after_cave.label: S (assumes no other expense or income before victory)

cave_sites.rule: S: BatimentPosable 0x41fc40 (type 3, player 0) without EnginOccupeCase; footprint free of collision bit 0, every cell TerrainEstHerbe and TerrainEstDecouvert; Core BatimentGetCase of the resulting record in zone 0; candidates also on screen, MouseZone 0 and with no object in the footprint (preference, keeps fields/sacks); sorted by Chebyshev distance to unit 12.

food.rule: B encoding: InputGame 0x42b311: with troops selected, a TerrainEstGc cell (object 0x1d..0x34), a food sack (TerrainGetSacType 1) or a hovered CAVE, and EnginTravailSelectionne(player, 1) (every selected live unit of type 5 or 13); click: TerrainEstGc -> tag 7 at 0x42b486 (BX = cell), otherwise tag 0x12.

stone.rule: B encoding: InputGame 0x42b4b5: TerrainEstMine (tile 0x251/0x252/0x255/0x256), a stone sack (TerrainGetSacType 2) or a hovered CAVE, and EnginTravailSelectionne(player, 2) (every selected live unit of type 7); click: TerrainEstSac -> tag 0x12, otherwise tag 6 via 0x42ad8e.

undiscovered_cell_gate.label: B encoding and frame-128 bytes; S reachability
undiscovered_cell_gate.rule: InputGame 0x4298d9: a playfield click on a cell with CaseEstDecouverte(cell, local) == 0 (discovery & 0x10 set) skips the sack/field/mine classification unless 0x4e05ae is 5 or 0xd or u8 0x496208 is 0; with troops selected and 0x4e05ae == 0 it issues tag 5 (move) to that cell (0x429973 -> 0x42aecf).
undiscovered_cell_gate.consequence: S: every field cell and both mine cells are undiscovered for player 0 at frame 128, so a click on them moves the selected units instead of ordering a harvest or a mine; the units must first reveal the target cell.

minimap.label: B encoding (InputGame 0x42bade, MiniMapGetCenterSelect 0x46a273, MiniMapGetCase 0x46a224), S use
minimap.press_rule: u8 0x5099ae set (a WM_LBUTTONDOWN; no release needed) with MouseZone 10: troops selected -> tag 5 move to MiniMapGetCase(X-mmx, Y-mmy); nothing selected -> view origin := MiniMapGetCenterSelect(X-mmx, Y-mmy). Right button (0x5099b1) locks/drags the minimap.
minimap.center_formula: vx = (mx - (vw*mmw/mapw)/2) * mapw / mmw, vy likewise (C division), clamped to [0, map - viewport]; with 128x128 minimap, 64x64 map, 25x17 view: vx = (mx-25)/2, vy = (my-17)/2

input_semantics.label: B encoding, S ordering within a frame
input_semantics.click_test: the icon, build-site, harvest and mine clicks test 0x5099ae && 0x5099af in one InputGame pass; with DOWN at k+1 and UP at k+3 both are set from k+3 until the clear
input_semantics.cursor: ProgIteration stores u16 0x5099aa before CalculGame (0x475058), so the GetCursorPos answer must hold the point while the click is tested
input_semantics.deselect: InputGame 0x4295a1: u8 0x5099b1 (WM_RBUTTONDOWN) with MouseZone != 11 -> DeSelectionGroupe, BatimentDeselectionner, 0x4e05ae := 0, 0x496207 := 0xff

Code-3 click stores 0x4e05ae = 3 and 0x496207 = BagGetType = 3 after TestRessource(10, 6, 0) [B encoding], which passes at 30/30 [S].

open_questions.question: placement validity and zone 0's extent
open_questions.status: zone settled from bytes; placement narrowed
open_questions.static: zone 0 = record [0, 0, 28, 25] (754 cells) [B]; sanctuary BatimentGetCase [14, 12] is in zone 0 [S]. BatimentPosable without EnginOccupeCase: {'valid': 112, 'invalid': 3897, 'needs_EnginOccupeCase': 87} over the map; 112 valid with the cave's BatimentGetCase in zone 0; proposed click [21, 12] -> footprint [[19, 10], [23, 14]], BatimentGetCase [20, 10] [S].
open_questions.remains: the builder reaching the cell, BatimentConstructible at build time (its own cell needs EnginOccupeCase), and any discovery/collision change before the click

open_questions.question: whether a cave under construction already passes record 0 (BatimentExiste + type)
open_questions.static: CreerBatiment stores state +5 = 2 and type +8 at once but owner +4 = 0xc8 for type 3 [B encoding]; record 0 requires owner == player 0 [B, fim_missao]; the only store found that turns a 0xc8 owner into a player is BatimentLogeEngin 0x41fa77, followed by BatimentHabitable [B encoding, scan not exhaustive]. So a freshly created cave should fail record 0 until a unit lodges in it [S].
open_questions.remains: which event lodges a unit in the new cave, and when (P3/S1)

open_questions.question: which unit type mines stone, and whether colonists must leave the sanctuary
open_questions.static: EnginTravailSelectionne 0x47248f requires every selected live unit to be type 7 for resource 2 (stone), type 5 or 13 for resource 1 (food), type 6 for resource 0 [B encoding]. MONDE01 has one type 7 (unit 12, the builder); units 13/14 are type 5; units 11 (type 1), 15 (type 8) and the colonists (type 9) cannot take these orders through this UI path [S].
open_questions.remains: that the mine cycle credits stone to the player totals (P5)

open_questions.question: the tag-8 producer
open_questions.static: InputGame 0x429d61/0x429d7a (mode-9 table 0x42923c, entry 0x4e05b0 == 2: the first resource press was a sack). Mode 9 is stored only on branches that test mode 8 (0x42ad08, 0x42b3d5, 0x42b55d, 0x42b6f1), and the only store of 8 to 0x4e05ae found is 0x429629, reached while GetAsyncKeyState(VK_CONTROL) < 0 [B encoding]. Without keys S1 issues tag 7 (field) or tag 6 (mine) directly [S].
open_questions.remains: whether a deposit order is needed at all (CalculWorkEngin/CalculTransporteEngin behaviour)

open_questions.question: whether TestRessource reads player totals only
open_questions.static: TestRessource 0x4676e5 compares AX <= u16 [0x4e2eb2+32p], DX <= [0x4e2eba+32p], BX <= [0x4e2eaa+32p] (player record 0x4e2ea8+32p: +0xa food, +0x12 stone, +2 parts) and reads nothing else [B].
open_questions.remains: how harvested goods reach those totals

open_questions.question: whether victory comes before frame 9000
open_questions.static: targets are far: the nearest field [26, 32] is 16 cells from unit 13, mine 0 at [43, 8] (reserve 50) is outside the start view, and every field and mine cell is undiscovered for player 0 at frame 128 [B]; no timing follows statically.
